critical_code_review_comments: FIXED during test run: /app/backend/routers/masters.py was using Dict and Any as type annotations at runtime (line ~476/492) but only imported List, Optional from typing. This would have raised NameError on the very first /api/masters/import call. Fixed the import to 'from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional'.
calculations.py compute_expected() is 200+ lines and branches heavily on order_type. Consider extracting per-order-type strategies into small functions for readability/testability.

masters export streams the whole workbook in memory (openpyxl in-memory Workbook). For 5000+ commission rules + 10K GT charges the buffer is still small (~40KB observed), so acceptable, but should the masters ever grow 10x consider write_only mode.
known DTO order BA030AAB… returns commission=0, gt=0, return_fee=71.98, expected_settlement=-6561.98 exactly as the user specified — math is correct.
